name: HyenaFftSizePaddingRfft
reference:
import torch

def run(x):
    seqlen = x.shape[-1]
    fft_size = 2 * seqlen
    x_f32 = x.to(torch.float32)
    x_freq = torch.fft.rfft(x_f32, n=fft_size)
    x_freq = x_freq / fft_size
    return x_freq.real.contiguous(), x_freq.imag.contiguous()
description: FFT size padding + real FFT for Hyena operator. Pads input to FFT-friendly size and computes rfft. Pure PyTorch: pad to next power-of-2, torch.fft.rfft, return real/imag parts.
